text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa... Haa...――

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"With this... every single training 
session for our summer training camp has 
officially concluded."
choice_data_list: You really did a great job...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Good work today, Trainer.

...Ikuno Dictus showed far more growth 
during this summer training camp than I 
had ever anticipated.

"With her current strength, she's sure to 
achieve a great result in the Shuka Sho—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"All that's left is to head back to the 
academy tomorrow... This year truly flew 
by in an instant."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'll be counting on you even after we get 
back to the academy, Trainer.

And so, summer training camp came to an 
end in the best possible way ahead of 
autumn, but—

As soon as we returned to the academy, a 
certain piece of news spread across the 
racing world.

Though Ines Fujin was supposed to be 
working toward her comeback, it was 
announced that she would go on an 
indefinite hiatus due to leg issues.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Indefinite... you're kidding, 
right!? Wait... seriously... no way...――

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Another Derby Umamusume, huh... It's an 
injury, so it can't be helped, but... what 
a shame..."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Did she push herself too hard at the 
Derby, I wonder...? Winning was amazing, 
but it leaves me with mixed feelings...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
…………I still can't forget how Ines-san ran 
in the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Her dazzling figure, having seized glory, 
is burned forever into my eyes."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Having her as a classmate of my generation 
is my pride. And at the same time—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume running in the present, I 
also feel that... I must be even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"A tough battle still awaits us at the 
Shuka Sho, so we must sharpen our 
self-management even further as we head 
into it."

Even as I gave her that reply, I was 
secretly troubled inside—

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
“An increase in racing capability directly 
leads to more intense race dynamics. In 
proportion, the required performance for 
victory is also elevated.”

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"Depending on race pacing and track 
conditions, there is a very real 
possibility this could become a harsher 
race than the recent Yushun Himba—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"It's truly, so wonderful... As an 
Umamusume myself...... I look up to you."

—Ikuno Dictus grew stronger over the 
summer. To an extent even I hadn't 
anticipated.

Even though it was supposed to be a joyous 
thing, it stirred up anxiety instead.

Wondering whether, with victory right 
before her eyes, her running might 
unexpectedly push her beyond her "limits"—

Unleashing the full extent of one's latent 
potential is not something just anyone can 
do.

Through relentless discipline and reaching 
top-tier prowess, one can finally knock on 
the gates of their limits. And then—

At Ikuno Dictus's current rate of growth, 
there's a high probability that the gate 
is already close by.

If she takes the time to accumulate 
experience, she should eventually be able 
to control that limit.

However, she won't make it in time for the 
Shuka Sho. In fact, the demanding race at 
the Shuka Sho might just push her past her 
limits—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Since you've been finely adjusting my 
training regimen again lately, aren't you 
feeling exhausted?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Please don't overexert yourself. Thanks to 
you, I've been making great progress on my 
end.

"I need to sort out my thoughts as soon as 
possible before the Shuka Sho. Autumn is 
already right around the corner, after 
all—"
